whoItsFor: Developers and teams using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode) who want interactive architecture diagrams, or source-backed system maps of a repository, from a description or code.
useCases: Diagram a system from a text description, such as a web request path through an API, cache, and database
Generate a source-backed architecture map of an existing code repository
Turn plans, itineraries, or learning maps into shareable interactive HTML
